items.title: Add a smokes aggregator and wire it into the lattice validate run path
items.context: Add a test:smokes (or similar) script that runs the wrapper-root / gitRoot smokes (storydir-inside-gitroot-smoke/suite, gitroot-cwd-routing, bare-gate-gitroot-cwd) and any other currently-orphaned smokes, and make lattice validate execute it (chain into root test, or a validate.command). Decide fast vs --full placement for slower fixture-building smokes.
items.userSees: lattice validate runs the wrapper-root smokes (their output appears in the validate run) and a deliberately-broken smoke makes lattice validate fail.

happy.desc: After wiring, `lattice validate` output lists each newly-gated guard step (process-fact-contract, runtime-fact-contract, evidence-quality, anti-stall, storydir-inside-gitroot-smoke, gitroot-cwd-routing, bare-gate-gitroot-cwd, done-oracle-wrapper-root) and exits PASS.
Root npm test chain runs the new guards in addition to the existing ones; no guard is double-listed (gitroot-cwd-contract appears exactly once).

edge.desc: The slow storydir-inside-gitroot-suite (~7s) and the 160-smoke test:all are NOT in the fast gate but remain reachable via the documented full/CI aggregator path.
Newly added root test:evidence-quality alias resolves to scripts/verify-evidence-quality.mjs and runs green.

adversarial.desc: A guard that is GREEN standalone must also be GREEN (and actually executed, not no-opped) when run inside the chained npm test context (cwd/env parity).

items.title: Verify the aggregated smokes run and pass under lattice validate; a regression blocks
items.context: Confirm lattice validate (and the CLI gate path) now executes the aggregated smokes green, and add a guard/test proving a smoke failure surfaces as a validate failure (no silent skip). Cross-check no double-run / excessive slowdown.
items.userSees: lattice validate GREEN with the smokes included; intentionally breaking one of them turns lattice validate red.
